attributes.board_name: Vermont Office of Professional Regulation – Physical Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Subjects related to the professional practice of physical therapy or patient/client management. Activities of OPR-approved providers count without application; other activities per OPR's CCU table or by individual approval (apply at least 90 days before renewal). Examples: academic PT coursework (1 credit = 15 CCUs), courses/seminars/conferences (1 class hour = 1 CCU), APTA Credentialed Clinical Instructor course (14 CCUs), CI Trainer (24), residency/fellowship (12 CCUs per year), ABPTS certification or recertification (24). Synchronous virtual courses count as live (H.305, 2023). No credit for rounds, staff meetings, case conferences or routine job teaching.
rules.audit_note: Completion certificates are uploaded with the online renewal; OPR also runs random audits (proof within 30 days). Keep documentation 5 years.
rules.legal_basis: Vermont Administrative Rules for Physical Therapists, Part 4 (eff. June 1, 2013); 26 V.S.A. chapter 38
rules.notes: OPR's CC table: generally 1 hour of activity = 1 CCU = 1 clock hour; 1 CEU = 10 contact hours = 10 CCUs. Licenses expire September 30 of even years (OPR fees and dates list); CE must fall within the two-year renewal cycle. No mandatory topics.
rules.rule_quote: Licensees must pay a renewal fee, and must have completed at least 24 hours of continuing competence activities for physical therapists and 16 hours of continuing competence activities for physical therapist assistants during the two years immediately preceding their respective renewal.
